about: workflow:find-workflows-that-can-never-fire: a daily and per-row-change sweep for workflow conditions that can never fire. One run-sql step; answers counts only.

payload.label: Find workflow conditions that can never fire
payload.job: Each day, and once when any workflow's own row changes: sweep every workflow row's conditions for ones the chooser can never judge (no made_by, or an operator that does not apply to its field kind), open one calendar task per problem, and close the tasks whose condition is fixed.
payload.produces: One calendar_tasks finding per unjudgeable condition, idempotent per recipe and condition, and the closed ones marked Done.

source.from: the workflow-router lane, 2026-11-21: a condition the chooser cannot evaluate is silently never chosen, so a sweep is the only place it is seen
source.note: The sweep runs in the pursuit's own database with one SQL statement; its answer is counts only.

credential_name.description: The pursuit database the workflow rows are kept in, as the switch's input names it (its vault name).

fires_when.label: a workflow's own definition was changed (any workflow_recipes row changed), so check it can still fire
fires_when.made_by: the person's AI, which wrote this workflow (Nov 21 2026)

steps.title: Open and close the unjudgeable-condition findings
steps.do: Run the sweep SQL in the pursuit's own database and return its counts only.

input.sql:
WITH conds AS (
  SELECT r.recipe, c.value AS c, c.ordinality AS n FROM workflow_recipes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.fires_when)='array' THEN r.fires_when ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY c
),
problems AS (
  SELECT k.recipe, k.n, k.c ->> 'label' AS label, 'made_by missing' AS why FROM conds k WHERE coalesce(k.c ->> 'made_by','') = ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT k.recipe, k.n, k.c ->> 'label', 'operator ' || (rule ->> 'operator') || ' does not apply to ' || (f ->> 'kind') || ' field ' || (rule ->> 'field')
  FROM conds k, jsonb_path_query(k.c, 'strict $.condition.tree.**') AS rt(rule), jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(k.c #> '{condition,fields}')='array' THEN k.c #> '{condition,fields}' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS ft(f)
  , rule_operators o
  WHERE o.operator = rule ->> 'operator' AND rule ->> 'kind' = 'rule' AND f ->> 'id' = rule ->> 'field' AND f ->> 'kind' <> 'fact' AND NOT (o.applies_to ? (f ->> 'kind'))
)
,
written AS (
  INSERT INTO calendar_tasks (id, title, description, labels, placed_by, status, job, plain_title, plain_detail)
  SELECT 'record:calendar-task:never-fire-' || md5(p.recipe || '|' || coalesce(p.label,'') || '|' || p.why),
    'A workflow condition can never fire: ' || p.recipe,
    'Recipe ' || p.recipe || ', condition ' || coalesce(p.label,'(unlabelled)') || '. Problem: ' || p.why || '.',
    '["finding","never-fire"]'::jsonb, 'find-workflows-that-can-never-fire', 'To do', p.recipe,
    'A workflow condition can never fire', 'Fix the condition so it can be judged.'
  FROM problems p
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
closed AS (
  UPDATE calendar_tasks t SET status = 'Done'
  WHERE t.id LIKE 'record:calendar-task:never-fire-%' AND t.status <> 'Done'
    AND t.id NOT IN (SELECT 'record:calendar-task:never-fire-' || md5(p.recipe || '|' || coalesce(p.label,'') || '|' || p.why) FROM problems p)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT row_to_json(x)::text FROM (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM written) AS opened, (SELECT count(*) FROM closed) AS closed_now, (SELECT count(*) FROM problems) AS problems_now) x
